title: Beta Project Manager
description:
Douglas Adams once said, "Technology is a word that describes something that doesn't work yet." Funny, because it's true — so much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people's lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household — and chances are good we've impacted your life already. We're full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We're always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a Beta Project Manager , you'll manage and support our customers' product tests (i.e., beta tests). This is a dynamic role that puts you in front of many of the most influential and innovative names in technology. If you've got the heart of a researcher, want to work directly with emerging tech, and love a good spreadsheet, this is the role for you.

What You'll Do as a Beta Project Manager

  • Become an expert at our platform and process
  • Work with our clients to scope projects to meet their goals
  • Identify ideal targeted test candidates based on client requirements
  • Collaborate on test logistics including unit shipping and retrieval
  • Triage customer feedback generate detailed reports
  • Support ongoing client data needs (generating custom reports, etc.)
  • Study feedback to provide insightful observations and analytics
  • Present results and recommendations to clients

What You Need to Do the Job

  • High technical aptitude in both software and hardware
  • Proven project planning and management skills
  • Experience digging into data and building reports
  • Previous experience delivering presentations to customers

What'll Give You an Edge

  • 2-4 years of experience working in a tech-related space
  • Experience in project or program management
  • Familiarity with research methodologies
  • Previous experience in a fast-paced agile tech environment

The Nitty Gritty

  • This is a full-time, remote position

  • Candidates must live in the United States

  • Sorry, Recruiters: We're not open to working with you on this role

  • We require a successful background check following offer acceptance

More About Us

Centercode is a highly innovative tech company and we're growing all the time. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech — the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They're very important to us.

You'll Fit Right In If

  • You love emerging tech — using it, talking about it, tinkering with it

  • You're obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity

  • You're not afraid to ask (or answer) stupid questions

  • You're a strong communicator but your an even better listener

  • You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet

  • Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work

  • You know your biggest weakness — and it isn't that you're a perfectionist

  • You're a Builder with a track record to prove it

  • You're willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)

  • You know the answer to the Ultimate Question

The Typical Perks You’d Expect

  • Medical + FSA

  • Voluntary Dental + Vision

  • 3 weeks of PTO annually ️ (plus more the longer you're with the company)

  • 401k matching

  • Other Voluntary Insurance: life, disability, pet, etc. ️

Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises

  • We pay for your phone (unlimited data!)

  • We pay for your home internet (unlimited cat videos!)

  • $1000 budget to turn your at-home workspace into a temple of productivity

  • Annual raises and bonuses (treat yo self )

  • Stock options

  • Discounts on fitness, electronics, entertainment, and more

  • IRL team-building events and parties in sunny Southern California

title: Senior Network Lead
description:
Overview

Job Title: Senior Network Lead

Department: Infrastructure

Job Location: Remote

About us:

Join us in revolutionizing healthcare! We build software that simplifies the process of choosing the right health insurance for individuals. Our solutions help our health plan and government customers with the administration, reporting, and operational requirements of their plans. By tackling the complexities of enrollment, administration, renewal, billing, and more, we enable our customers and partners to concentrate on advancing their core missions.

Our Company Culture:

Our culture is built on collaboration, innovation, and appreciation. We value each employee's unique talents and contributions and understand that every individual plays a critical role in our mission to transform healthcare. Every day, we celebrate our team's dedication, creativity, and expertise, which drive us closer to our goals.

At Softheon, our mission is making healthcare more affordable, accessible, and plentiful for every American. Our vision is that everyone can access and choose the healthcare they need.

About the role

The Senior Network Lead is a key technical leader responsible for the vision, strategy, and execution of Softheon’s network infrastructure. This role oversees all aspects of network engineering, drives innovation, ensures operational excellence, and leads a team of network professionals. The Senior Network Lead partners with senior leadership to align network initiatives with business objectives and regulatory requirements, while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration. This is a hybrid role that includes people management responsibilities however, the majority of the role is hands-on: network engineering, troubleshooting, design, maintenance, and direct operational work.

You Will

Strategic Leadership & Planning

  • Develop and execute the network technology roadmap to support current and future business needs.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives to modernize and secure network infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance for large-scale network projects and migrations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of network engineers and administrators.
  • Set clear performance expectations, provide regular feedback, and support career growth.
  • Foster a collaborative and innovative team environment, encouraging knowledge sharing and best practices.

Network Architecture & Engineering Excellence

  • Oversee the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise network solutions.
  • Ensure network architectures are secure, scalable, and aligned with industry best practices.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies to enhance performance, reliability, and security.

Operational Management & Support

  • Oversee advanced troubleshooting and resolution of complex network issues.
  • Manage critical incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of network services through proactive monitoring and maintenance.

Security, Compliance & Risk Management

  • Define and enforce network security policies and controls.
  • Collaborate with the Security Team to address vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI DSS).
  • Lead security assessments and remediation efforts.

Vendor, Stakeholder & Executive Engagement

  • Manage vendor relationships and negotiate contracts for network equipment and services.
  • Collaborate with senior leadership and business stakeholders to align network strategy with organizational goals.
  • Communicate network strategy, risks, and performance to executives in a clear and actionable manner.

Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Drive automation, process improvement, and operational efficiency initiatives.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and regulatory changes.
  • Champion the adoption of best practices and innovative solutions across the organization.

Talent Management

  • Partner with the Talent and Infrastructure leadership teams in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new team members.
  • Contribute to building a high-performing team by coaching others, sharing knowledge, and promoting skill development across infrastructure domains.
  • Advocate for a collaborative, inclusive, and transparent work culture that aligns with organizational values.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Must be available for on-call duty during peak periods, providing support outside of regular working hours as needed to ensure the timely resolution of critical issues.
  • Although we work in a remote-first environment, all roles requires in-person attendance at our headquarters approximately 2 times per year (in addition to other travel requirements for this specific role, if applicable). These visits are essential for team collaboration, strategic planning, and fostering deeper connections across the organization. Travel arrangements will be supported to ensure a seamless experience.

You Have

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Required Certifications

  • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)
  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP)

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) - Must get within 90 days of employment
  • Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) - Must get within 90 days of employment
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Network Engineer Associate (AZ-700)
  • Other relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Advanced Networking, Juniper, Palo Alto, CISSP, CISM)

Experience

  • At least 7 years of progressive experience in network engineering
  • Minimum of 1 year supervising, mentoring, or leading technical teams; direct reporting experience preferred but not required.
  • Extensive experience designing and implementing enterprise network architectures.
  • Proven track record leading large-scale network projects and migrations.
  • Experience managing teams and developing talent.
  • Strong background in cloud networking (Azure, AWS) and hybrid environments.
  • Advanced troubleshooting skills across complex network environments.
  • Experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SolarWinds, PRTG, Nagios, vRealize Operations).

Knowledge & Skills

  • Deep expertise in networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, BGP, OSPF, etc.).
  • Strong proficiency in firewall configuration, VPN technologies, and network security.
  • Familiarity with ITIL practices for incident, problem, and change management.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong technical writing and documentation abilities.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate at all levels of the organization.

Attributes

  • Strategic thinker with a focus on business outcomes and innovation.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven.
  • Adaptable and resilient in fast-paced, dynamic environments.
  • Committed to continuous learning and professional development.

What We Offer

Softheon offers every full-time employee a comprehensive compensation and benefits package including:

  • Base pay for this position ranges from $119,000 to $159,000 per year, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation, and benefits. Note that the base pay shown is a guideline and total compensation varies by qualifications, skill level, and competencies.
  • Work from home with a one-time home office stipend
  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, vision, and dental coverage for you, your spouse, and dependents
  • Additional benefits including a monthly wellness stipend and internet stipend, 401K with a match (immediately vested), employee assistance program, disability/life insurance, and parental leave
  • 15 days of discretionary PTO based on years of service
  • 9 additional paid holidays
  • Referral bonuses, discretionary bonus program, spot bonuses, and professional development opportunities

*Please note that candidates applying for this position must reside within the United States.

Eligibility to Work in the U.S.: We are unable to sponsor or assist with visa-related processes. Candidates must have valid work authorization to work in the U.S. without any current or future need for employer sponsorship.

Join Softheon, and together, we\'ll shape the future of healthcare in America.

Are you ready to make a difference? Join us at Softheon and help revolutionize healthcare for all.

About the role

Hello talented professionals! We’re expanding our pool of talent and invite skilled individuals to apply. While specific positions may not be available immediately, we’re proactively building a network of qualified candidates for future paid partnerships.

If you’re passionate about game development, eager to showcase and improve your skills on major titles, and open to potential partnerships down the line, we encourage you to apply and become part of our expert talent community. We look forward to connecting with you.

A 3D generalist is a multi-talented professional capable of managing various facets of the 3D production process, including modeling, texturing, lighting, rigging, animation, rendering, and compositing. They embody versatility, adaptability, and creativity, making them well-suited for diverse projects and genres.

Here's what you can expect

  • Profile preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values
  • Talent Acquisition Interview: Selected candidates will discuss their experience, skills, and fit for the role
  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made

We’re committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team and look forward to connecting with you throughout this process.

The Quest

  • Concept interpretation : Translate 2D concepts and references into high-quality 3D models or sculpts with fidelity to the original design while adding necessary details to achieve leveling, style and craftsmanship with minimal direction.
  • High poly modeling and sculpting : Use industry-standard software to create detailed models that tell a story and meet artistic and technical requirements for the project.
  • Low poly and mid poly creation : Create game-ready versions with optimized topology, efficient UVs, and meeting technical requirements.
  • Textures creation : Use Photoshop and Substance Painter to create high-quality texture maps that accurately represent materials and align with project style.
  • Rigging and animation support : Collaborate with animators and riggers to prepare models for animation, providing clean topology and rig-friendly meshes, and help integrate animations into the game engine.
  • Optimization and performance : Optimize assets for performance and memory usage, implementing LODs and other techniques.
  • Asset integration : Export assets and integrate them in a game engine.
  • Efficient time management : Work efficiently to meet phase timelines and delivery dates.
  • Teamwork : Collaborate with other artists to solve problems and communicate about quality, technical, or delivery issues.
  • Punctuality : Present progress daily and/or when requested, and assist in meetings as needed.

The Skills

  • Strong polygonal modeling skills with clean, efficient, well-integrated and leveled models that meet project requirements.
  • Understanding of technical foundations to manage assets for memory and performance considerations.
  • Strong artistic sensibilities related to color theory, composition, scale, design, shape language, and craft basics, with understanding of proportions and industrial design.
  • PBR workflow and efficient/organized texture creation, with understanding of physically based workflows to achieve believable assets and story.
  • Familiarity with game engines such as Unity or Unreal Engine.
  • High degree of self-direction while being a team player with strong verbal and written communication, and openness to feedback.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and proactive approach to technical and artistic challenges in 3D asset creation.
  • Strong knowledge of pipelines , workflows and asset exporting processes.
  • Quick learner of new processes and software as needed.
  • 3–5 years of experience in the video game industry and at least 3 credited games.

Software Expertise

  • Maya, 3ds Max, Blender or equivalent software
  • Unreal Engine 5 and Unity
  • ZBrush
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Substance Painter
  • Substance Designer is a plus

Required Application Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • Cover letter
  • Reel or portfolio demonstrating the art and technical skills

The Reward

  • Competitive project-based compensation
  • Opportunity to work on exciting and diverse projects
  • Clear communication and support throughout the project duration
  • Flexibility in project timelines and deadlines
  • Potential for long-term collaboration on future projects

description:
Overview

Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc. (NASDAQ: INOD). Remote, flexible contract (part-time, up to 25 hours weekly).

About the Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will help shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model’s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment (mandatory & non-billable).

  • Location: Remote

description:
Analista de Suporte - Folha de Pagamento

Analista de Folha de Pagamento (área Suporte)

Você busca desenvolver sua carreira dentro da área Contábil e Fiscal em uma empresa líder no segmento de Tecnologia? Junte-se a nós!

A Thomson Reuters combina a inteligência, tecnologia e expertise humana para fornecer respostas confiáveis que ajudam os profissionais a tomar decisões confiantes e administrar melhor seus negócios. Nós os ajudamos a reinventar a maneira como os profissionais trabalham, nossa equipe de especialistas reúne informação, inovação e insight para desvendar situações complexas nos mercados Tributário, Comércio Exterior, contábil e Jurídico, respaldando nossos clientes na tomada de decisão.

Sobre a Posição

Nesta oportunidade, como Analista de Suporte - Folha de Pagamento , você será responsável por oferecer um atendimento técnico de excelência aos clientes que utilizam os módulos de Folha de Pagamento do sistema Domínio. Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:

  • Prestar suporte funcional via telefone, garantindo um atendimento claro, empático e eficiente.

  • Atuar com foco na resolução de problemas e na melhoria contínua do serviço prestado.
  • Compreender a jornada do cliente e direcioná-lo conforme suas necessidades específicas.
  • Intermediar solicitações de ajustes e correções junto às equipes de Produto.
  • Promover os valores e comportamentos da Thomson Reuters no dia a dia.
  • Manter-se constantemente atualizado sobre as soluções oferecidas e a legislação vigente na área de Folha de Pagamento.

Sobre Você

Para esta posição, buscamos profissionais com as Habilidades & Experiência:

  • Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Ciências Contábeis, Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas. Candidatos sem graduação também são bem-vindos — caso aprovados no processo seletivo, serão contratados como Técnicos.

  • Facilidade para trabalhar com metas e foco em resultados.
  • Adaptabilidade a processos estruturados e rotinas organizadas.
  • Boa comunicação, empatia e habilidade para atuar em equipe.

Desejáveis:

  • Experiência prévia na área de Folha de Pagamento.
  • Experiência prévia com a Solução Domínio.

O que iremos te oferecer?

  • Modelo de Trabalho Híbrido: ambiente de trabalho híbrido e flexível (2-3 dias por semana no escritório, dependendo do papel) para funções baseadas em escritório.
  • Flexibilidade e Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal: políticas para facilitar a gestão das responsabilidades pessoais e profissionais, com possibilidade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar por até 8 semanas por ano.
  • Desenvolvimento e Crescimento Profissional: cultura de aprendizado contínuo e desenvolvimento de habilidades, programa Grow My Way e foco em habilidades para crescer e prosperar com IA.
  • Benefícios Competitivos do Setor: planos de benefícios que incluem assistência médica e odontológica, dois dias de feriado corporativo para saúde mental, programas de incentivo por performance e bem-estar.

  • Impacto Social: oportunidades de voluntariado remunerado e iniciativas ESG através do Instituto de Impacto Social.
  • Missão e Propósito: atuação para promover justiça, verdade e transparência, contribuindo para o estado de direito e o comércio global.

Quem somos

A Thomson Reuters informa o caminho adiante ao reunir conteúdo confiável e a tecnologia que pessoas e organizações precisam para tomar decisões corretas. Servimos profissionais nos setores jurídico, fiscal, contábil, de conformidade, governamental e de mídia. Nossos produtos combinam software altamente especializado e informações para capacitar profissionais com dados, inteligência e soluções para decisões informadas. A Reuters, parte da Thomson Reuters, é líder mundial em jornalismo e notícias confiáveis. Contamos com o talento de 26.000 colaboradores em mais de 70 países, buscando objetividade, precisão, equidade e transparência. Overview

JLL empowers you to shape a brighter way .

Our people at JLL and JLL Technologies are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people and empowering them to thrive, grow meaningful careers and to find a place where they belong. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

Location: REMOTE based in the United States

Category Manager – Hard Services - What this job involves

Develop and manage hard service categories such as: MEP, FP, to achieve organizational goals by: develop category strategies, leverage scale, build supplier relationships, identify and bring forward market innovations, support client solutions and providing overall value to stakeholders in support of all JLL client managed spend.

Summary

  • Develops and regularly maintains short, mid and long-term category strategies aligned with overall business strategy and objectives and departmental stakeholders
  • Forges key strategic relationships with strategic suppliers and industry leaders and develops those relationships, being mindful of long-term mutually beneficial and ethical objectives as well as providing the business with access to supplier innovation
  • Manages category-specific segmentation of service providers and supply partners to ensure that we have the best service provision available across the category to deliver value to our internal and external clients
  • Shares market intelligence, best practices and provides category expertise in improving cost, performance and overall value to end users.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Responsible for category strategy development, execution and category performance of all category related activities.
  • Delivery of financial targets in line with business expectations. CM continuously drives the category opportunity agenda and self-sufficiently identifies, agrees and executes these projects
  • Accountable for creating strategic solution for specific commodity and service requirements, procurement event planning, RFP/quotation management, bid analysis and recommendations, liaison with internal stakeholders for contract approvals, savings reporting, documentation and compliance.
  • Utilize and enhance supply chain data analytics to assess current state needs and portfolio and enable more strategic thought leadership
  • Rationalizes supply base and develops clear strategic supply partner framework and maintains this framework at senior supplier level
  • Use market and industry intelligence to identify and qualify new suppliers and use data to support the business and delivery of services. In addition, identify risk, threats and provide solutions for mitigation.
  • Utilize SRM tools to manage relationship with JLL preferred supply base. Act as the internal issue resolution point and review performance regularly
  • Provide functional leadership and peer group alignment, where appropriate and needed
  • Identify opportunities to develop and implement new policies and procedures, including rationalization of legacy policies and procedures
  • Prepare high quality papers and presentations for use with internal and external stakeholders and/or teams as required
  • Apply ethical company standards and ensure Global Procurement policy is applied always

Sourcing Process Expectations

  • Develop category plan with the ability to provide visibility such as supplier summaries, stakeholder engagement plans, contract summaries, and market insights that lead to both short and long-term strategies
  • Ability to negotiate and have proven strategies within areas of responsible spend
  • Lead development and execution of all sourcing-related functions- performing due diligence and assessment of prospective suppliers, executing RFPs/bids, negotiating contracts and ensuring effective transition to operations during implementation
  • Partner with functional leads and the business to drive both immediate and sustained benefits to JLL and its clients
  • Bring strategic thought leadership to identify additional cost and operational efficiencies
  • Proactively manage internal stakeholder expectations and escalate at appropriate times
  • Manage savings tracking and work with sourcing managers and key suppliers, ensure that savings initiatives ideas are being driven to maximize savings impacts
  • Conduct supplier performance review meetings, manage supplier scorecards, contract compliance and service obligations
  • Subject matter expert for category and main point of contact within JLL

Sound like you? To apply you need to have:

  • Bachelor’s Degree / Degree in Procurement or Supply Chain preferred.
  • 5-7 years procurement-related experience.
  • Excellent Inter-personal skills, Organization skills, Strong Analytical Ability
  • Ability work on a regional scale and across different time zones.
  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written
  • Proven ability to facilitate strategic supplier relationships and work with senior business executives and across procurement leadership
  • Collaborative and influencing style with a focus on team work
  • Proven ability to deliver results in challenging environments
  • Expertise in sourcing with demonstrated ability to manage change
  • Ability to sell and present initiatives and/or new ideas
  • Experience in sourcing indirect corporate services and products
  • Excellent PC skills, proficient in MS applications with excellent ability to work with large amounts of data and build reports
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict timelines.

description:
Overview

Descrição da vaga. Para atuar no grupo de Instalações e Automação Predial (IAp) da Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI). O grupo de Instalações e Automação Predial (IAP) é responsável por desenvolver projetos, realizar estudos de viabilidade, implantar e integrar sistemas de infraestrutura, supervisionando sua construção e garantindo a conclusão dos projetos com altos padrões de qualidade e segurança. Com uma equipe multidisciplinar, atua em conjunto com os diversos profissionais do CNPEM, trabalhando em projetos inovadores e criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades do centro de pesquisa.

Responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de projetos de instalações de diferentes disciplinas: elétrica, automação, cabeamento estruturado, detecção de incêndio, controle de acesso e CFTV
  • Coletar dados, apoiar nos projetos de instalações fazendo análises e identificando falhas e oportunidades de melhorias
  • Apoiar na fiscalização de serviços de instalações e execução das obras, garantindo que sejam atendidas as normas técnicas e utilizadas as boas práticas de instalação visando a qualidade, funcionalidade e prazos contratados
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente o cronograma físico/financeiro, elaborar relatórios e demais documentos que auxiliem a gestão do contrato
  • Participar de reuniões de projetos

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Superior completo em Engenharia Elétrica; Engenharia de Controle e Automação ou áreas correlatas
  • Desejável conhecimento em instalações industriais
  • Conhecimento de normas técnicas
  • Conhecimento em Pacote Office e AutoCAD
  • Inglês intermediário

Informações adicionais

Nossos Benefícios

  • Assistência Médica – Unimed
  • Assistência Odontológica – Uniodonto
  • Assistência Psicológica – Telavita
  • Seguro de Vida – Allianz
  • Previdência Privada – BrasilPrev
  • Licença Maternidade (estendida por 6 meses)
  • Licença Paternidade (25 dias)
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Restaurante no local
  • Vale Alimentação e/ou Refeição – Pluxee (R$1.020,00/mês)
  • Fretado
  • Vale Transporte
  • Estacionamento no local
  • Clube – Telecamp
  • Clube – Associação SESC gratuita
  • Wellhub – desconto em academias
  • Convênios com empresas que oferecem descontos

Reafirmamos nosso compromisso com a diversidade, equidade e inclusão, incentivando a candidatura de pessoas com deficiência, neurodivergentes, mulheres, LGBTI+, de diversas etnias, gerações e corpos, além de outros grupos socialmente marginalizados.

Faça parte do CNPEM!

No Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM), somos movidos pela paixão pela ciência. Nosso ambiente é um vibrante centro de pesquisa e desenvolvimento, onde profissionais de diversas especialidades se conectam para enfrentar desafios complexos e criar soluções para problemas relevantes, especialmente nas áreas de saúde, energia, materiais renováveis e sustentabilidade.

Somos uma Organização Social supervisionada pelo Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação (MCTI), na vanguarda da pesquisa científica no Brasil. Somos responsáveis pelo Sirius, a maior infraestrutura científica já construída no País, e atualmente, desenvolvemos o projeto Orion, um complexo laboratorial dedicado a pesquisas avançadas em patógenos, que estará disponível para a comunidade científica nacional e internacional.

Oferecemos uma ampla gama de oportunidades de carreira para profissionais de diferentes perfis. No CNPEM, conduzimos pesquisas de ponta que abrangem nanotecnologia, biociências, biotecnologia, biorrenováveis, instrumentação científica e física de aceleradores, conduzidas, respectivamente, pelos Laboratórios Nacionais de Nanotecnologia (LNNano), Biociências (LNBio), Biorrenováveis (LNBR) e Luz Síncrotron (LNLS). Essas iniciativas são fortalecidas por projetos tecnológicos desafiadores e pela busca de soluções na fronteira das engenharias, liderados pela Diretoria Adjunta de Tecnologia (DAT).

Todo esse ecossistema é sustentado por uma rede integrada de áreas estratégicas que inclui tecnologia da informação, comunicação, gestão de projetos, assessoria jurídica & compliance, recursos humanos, finanças, compras, sustentabilidade e inovação, alocadas entre Diretoria Geral (DG) e Diretoria de Serviços Compartilhados (DSC). A Diretoria Adjunta de Infraestrutura (DAI) assegura a manutenção das instalações, o suporte à engenharia e o desenvolvimento arquitetônico, criando condições ideais para o avanço de todas as atividades.

A Ilum Escola de Ciência complementa essas frentes com um curso de bacharelado em Ciência e Tecnologia, oferecendo uma formação inovadora que prepara novas gerações de cientistas para os desafios do futuro.

Acreditamos que o sucesso é alcançado por meio de dedicação, colaboração e propósito claro. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento contínuo dos nossos profissionais e estudantes, oferecendo um ambiente inspirador e favorável para o crescimento profissional e pessoal.

Estamos comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e buscamos soluções que promovam um futuro mais verde. Prezamos pelo cuidado e bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, ao mesmo tempo em que valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas são bem-vindas e respeitadas.

Se você é apaixonado por ciência e busca um lugar onde você possa fazer a diferença, junte-se a nós no CNPEM.

Job summary

We have the opportunity for an enthusiastic midwife to cover this position for 09 months.

The post holder will act as an expert practitioner, resource and role model in order to develop and maintain an effective clinical learning environment, using clinical evidence to facilitate 'best practice'. They will provide line management, leadership and support to the practice development teams across the Trust to ensure women, birthing people and their families receive quality care at all times.

Interview date TBC

Main duties

The post holder will work closely with the senior midwifery team and the lead obstetricians for education to ensure all standards are achieved, and a robust process is in place to meet all governance agendas. Supporting the leadership strategy to ensure that the needs of women and birthing people are placed at the centre of care and service delivery. This will include the review/development of clinical guidelines, implementing midwifery practice development plans and actions in response to risk case reviews and clinical supervision reviews. They will action and implement national and local recommendations in relation to clinical practice updates and training. The post holder will maintain a training data base recording all statutory and mandatory training and act as the main point of contact for HEI providers in relation to student commissioning and any issues in clinical practice. As a member of the senior midwifery team the post holder will form part of the senior midwifery on-call service and undertake directorate and trust wide projects as required.

Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is one of England\'s top-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites--Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital--along with award-winning clinics across North West London.

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and Westminster and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Middlesex.

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe that diversity drives innovation and excellence. As part of our dedication to equity, we actively welcome applications from individuals from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities. We value the unique perspectives and experiences that diverse teams bring and are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, respected, and empowered to succeed.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world\'s biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master\'s or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences.   • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

description:

Why should you join dLocal? dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets. By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 1000+ teammates from 30+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Business Intelligence team, with a strong focus on data pipelines, predictive analytics and dashboarding. The ideal candidate will join a team that takes full responsibility for designing, developing and maintaining the Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics platform: from designing ETLs and scalable data models to applying advanced statistical and machine learning methods, and building interactive dashboards that drive decision-making across the company.

What will I be doing?

  • Implement and maintain data pipelines, ensuring data quality, consistency and scalability across the BI and Advanced Analytics platforms.
  • Detect and correct errors in our BI Platform and processes in order to guarantee reliability.
  • Translate business requirements into predictive models, dashboards, simulations, and analytical frameworks.
  • Design and implement forecasting solutions (time series, ML-based predictors) to anticipate trends in payment volumes, revenues, and customer behavior.
  • Develop and deploy machine learning models into production pipelines.
  • Hands-on analysis, design and development of interactive dashboards and data visualizations that combine descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive insights.
  • Build automated reporting and alerting solutions, integrating predictive and real-time metrics.
  • Ensure timeliness, resilience, availability and accessibility of data.
  • Maintain and extend documentation of BI & ML architecture, processes, and procedures.
  • Stay up-to-date with industry standards, forecasting techniques, visualization best practices, and ML frameworks.
  • Contribute to the definition of standards and best practices for data science, analytics engineering, and dashboarding.
  • Work closely with Data Engineers, Analysts, and Product teams to deliver robust predictive and visualization solutions.

What skills do I need?

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in Analytics Engineering / Data Science.
  • Strong expertise in SQL (Redshift, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Solid knowledge of data modeling, ETL processes, and cloud data platforms (AWS / GCP: EMR, Lambda, EC2, S3, Athena, Redshift).
  • Experience with forecasting techniques (ARIMA, Prophet, exponential smoothing, machine learning regressors, deep learning models).
  • Proficiency in Python (Pandas, Scikit-learn, Statsmodels, PyTorch/TensorFlow is a plus).
  • Familiarity with Spark for large-scale data processing.
  • Experience with Airflow, DBT, DataHub, Github.
  • Strong understanding of statistical modeling, feature engineering, and predictive analytics.
  • Proven experience building dashboards and data visualizations (Looker, Power BI, Tableau or similar), with ability to translate data into actionable insights and compelling stories.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills with a holistic approach to business and data.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Ability to translate complex user requirements into technical, predictive, and visualization solutions.
  • Curious mindset, ability to learn new technologies quickly.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in cross-functional teams.

What do we offer?

  • Remote work: work from anywhere or one of our offices around the globe!
  • Flexibility: we have flexible schedules and we are driven by performance.
  • Fintech industry: work in a dynamic and ever-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.
  • Referral bonus program: our internal talents are the best recruiters - refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.
  • Learning & development: get access to a Premium Coursera subscription.
  • Language classes: we provide free English, Spanish, or Portuguese classes.
  • Social budget: you\'ll get a monthly budget to chill out with your team (in person or remotely) and deepen your connections!
  • dLocal Houses: want to rent a house to spend one week anywhere in the world coworking with your team? We’ve got your back!

*For people based in Montevideo (Uruguay) applying to non-IT roles, 55% monthly attendance to the office is required

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

description:
Implementation Consultant (Remote) at Intelex Technologies

Why work with us as a consultant?

As an Intelexian, this role is critical to helping our customers, drive positive change by implementing and configuring solutions to achieve their Health and Safety Business Goals.

What will you be working on?

As a Consultant , you will be considered a trusted advisor across the entire implementation project lifecycle. Your role involves delivering solutions to both new and existing mid-market and enterprise customers, handling projects with varying scope and complexity. Collaborating with customers across all industries, you will lead efforts to capture, document, and configure requirements. Additionally, you will conduct testing, training, and support go-live activities, to ensure customer satisfaction and desired outcomes are achieved. Your role involves achieving specific targets related to quality, customer satisfaction, on-time delivery, and utilization.

Responsibilities

  • Serve the customer as a trusted advisor throughout the entire implementation project lifecycle, articulating the impact of solution design, and adhering to scope, budget, and schedule.
  • Manage customer and internal project team relationships, and communication throughout project ensuing the customer and internal project team is kept up to date on the status of projects or tasks.
  • Lead onsite and remote meetings and workshops with customer project team, encompassing activities such as requirements gathering, and configuration reviews to ensurethe solution is aligned with customer requirements.
  • Offer solutions when faced with challenges or scope adjustments, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of customers’ needs and project goals.
  • Contribute to the development and management of change orders, providing estimations and recommendations to navigate scope, budget and timeline changes effectively.
  • Perform solution testing, and coordinate with quality assurance teams for QA testing and the customer, during User Acceptance Testing.
  • Develop and deliver onsite or remote customer-specific training programs during the project implementations.
  • Assists Support teams with resolution of customer configuration defects.
  • In-frequent travel (up to 20%) to customer sites

Who will you be working with?

  • This role sits in our Professional Services organization, within the Consulting Function, reporting to the Manager, Consulting.
  • You will have access to the entire Global Services community for support, consisting of incredibly talented, Peers, Project Managers, Solution Architects and Subject Matter Experts.
  • A tenured member of the team will be your dedicated Intelexian mentor, for the duration of your onboarding.

What can you expect working with Intelex?

  • A unique opportunity to contribute first-hand to a bigger purpose, helping our customers eliminate Injury/Illness on the job.
  • Ability to flex your consulting and configuration skills with our customers from around the world and across a variety of industries.
  • Elevate your technical skills, developing expertise on the Intelex platform as well as other software and integrations that we leverage to support our customers (such as Datamaran, Enhesa, Verisk, and Workday)
  • Opportunity to configure across multiple devices (desktop, mobile etc.)

You are exactly what we are looking for if you have:

  • A consulting background, with 5+ years technical implementation consulting experience of SaaS solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with software and integration configuration, including coding (e.g., XML/HTML) to format structure and layout of SaaS software.
  • Good understanding of cloud technology principles and service delivery organization targets.
  • Proven ability to analyze complex enterprise-level challenges and deliver innovative, practical solutions.
  • A passion for customer satisfaction, demonstrated through effective relationship management and delivering positive outcomes.
  • Experience managing mid-market and enterprise projects with ambitious deadlines in dynamic, fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent presentation skills, with the ability to present business and project solutions effectively to diverse audiences, including technical experts and director-level stakeholders.
  • Skilled at identifying obstacles, troubleshooting issues, and seeking support when needed.
  • The ability to deeply engage with customers, uncover their core needs, and address the real problems they aim to solve by tailoring solutions to desired outcomes.
  • A consultative approach that involves deeply understanding customer needs, addressing core problems, and tailoring solutions to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Proactive mindset, able to anticipates customer needs beyond initial requests, simplifies processes, and delivers efficient, user-friendly solutions.
  • A dedication to customer success, ensuring customer satisfaction through clear, consistent communication and follow-ups to confirm issues are resolved.

Our culture is what makes Intelex a great place to work. You’re fit right in if this sounds like you:

  • Customer Obsessed, always seeking to understand customer choices, and ways to delight our customers.
  • A team player, constantly considering ways to improve performance, and support others to ensure the team’s overall success.
  • An innovator, with an inquisitive mind, actively seeking new ways of working, through experimentation to solve problems.
  • Courageous, willing to respond to challenge and take on the unknown.
  • Deliver results, setting high personal expectations for your own performance.
  • Adaptable, and therefore comfortable dealing with uncertainty, complexity, and change.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, particularly with regards to communicating and negotiating with customers and colleagues of all levels within anorganization.

Do you want to have quick sneak peek at your onboarding and year one journey at Intelex?

Within 1 month, you will:

  • Participate in Corporate onboarding - Learn about Intelex, our parent companies, our history, and our values.
  • Participate in Departmental onboarding - Learn our software, our methodology and how you fit into the organization.
  • Work with an onboarding mentor - Gain mentorship through your onboarding programs and beyond. Learn the ins and outs from someone doing the job.
  • 1:1 - Meet the team, leadership, individuals across the organization. Make friends and build your internal network.

Within 2 months, you will:

  • Complete key Departmental onboarding assignments - Learning the key components to the role, ensuring you are ready to be customer-facing
  • Start a project with the support of your Mentor, Manager, and the entire team
  • Take on other ad-hoc customer facing or behind the scenes customer work.

Within 4 months, you will:

  • Fully ramping up, with role-specific critical metrics and targets.
  • Growing your knowledge - Learning more Intelex software components and features.

Within 1 year, you will:

  • Effectively manage four or more concurrent projects, as well as deliver sustainment services for customer enhancements.
  • Guide customers towards standard methodologies and industry best practice.
  • Become an Onboarding Mentor - helping the next generation learn and grow.
  • Achieve positive customer feedback for quality and delivery.

Once selected, you would have to:

  • Intelex will perform background and criminal record checks.

Let’s Build a Safer, Cleaner World Together!

We welcome you to work with us, let’s together make a difference in the world by helping companies become more sustainable by keeping their employees safe, minimising their environmental impacts, and improving the quality of their products.

Here at Intelex we embrace diversity, encourage innovation, support professional growth and care about your work/life balance. If you want to learn more about us and how we are working towards achieving our vision of reducing deaths on the job by 2050, visit our site

No Stone Entrega, nossa missão é resolver um dos maiores desafios para o empreendedor brasileiro: a logística. Construímos a ponte entre o negócio do nosso cliente e uma malha logística inteligente, permitindo que ele foque no que realmente importa: vender.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring Python and Kubernetes Specialist Engineers focused on Data, AI/ML and Analytics Solutions to join our teams building open source solutions for public cloud and private infrastructure.
As a software engineer on the team, you'll collaborate on an end-to-end data analytics and mlops solution composed of popular, open-source, machine learning tools, such as Kubeflow, MLFlow, DVC, and Feast. You may also work on workflow, ETL, data governance and visualization tools like Apache SuperSet, dbt, and Temporal, or data warehouse solutions such as Apache Trino, or ClickHouse. Your team will own a solution from the analytics and machine learning space, and integrate with the solutions from other teams to build the world's best end-to-end data platform. These solutions may be run on servers or on the cloud, on machines or on Kubernetes, on developer desktops, or as web services.
We serve the needs of individuals and community members as much as the needs of our Global 2000 and Fortune 500 customers; we make our primary work available free of charge and our Pro subscriptions are also available to individuals for personal use at no cost. Our goal is to enable more people to enjoy the benefits of open source, regardless of their circumstances.
Location: This initiative spans many teams that are home-based and in multiple time zones. We believe in distributed collaboration but we also try to ensure that colleagues have company during their work hourse! Successful candidates will join a team where most members and your manager are broadly in the same time zone so that you have the benefits of constant collaboration and discussion.
What your day will look like

  • Develop your understanding of the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, and storage, to the application layer
  • Design, build and maintain solutions that will be deployed on public and private clouds and local workstations
  • Master distributed systems concepts such as observability, identity, tracing
  • Work with both Kubernetes and machine-oriented open source applications
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team of engineers, designers and product managers

  • Generate and discuss ideas, and collaborate on finding good solutions
What we are looking for in you
  • Professional or academic software delivery using Python
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
Additional Skills That Would Be Nice To Have

The following skills may be helpful to you in the role, but we don't expect everyone to bring all of them.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning libraries, or tools.
  • Proven track record of building highly automated machine learning solutions for the cloud.
  • Experience with container technologies (Docker, LXD, Kubernetes, etc.)
  • Experience with public clouds (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)
  • Working knowledge of cloud computing
  • Passionate about software quality and testing
  • Experience working on an open source project
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Join to apply for the Cloud Field Engineering Manager role at Canonical .

This is an opportunity to lead a field engineering team, helping customers understand and implement Canonical's open source solutions across public clouds and data centers. The role involves working with a broad spectrum of cloud offerings, from Ubuntu to virtualization, private cloud, Kubernetes, and advanced open source solutions like MLops platforms and data platforms. As Canonical expands into new industries such as telecom, finance, healthcare, and media, we develop new open source solutions tailored to their needs.

We believe that Engineering Managers should be outstanding engineers, comfortable troubleshooting technical issues and engaging in technical presales. Our goal is to make open source easier, reliable, and secure, aiming to provide 'most software to most companies'. We select engineers globally for brilliance and motivation, and our managers help teams achieve their potential and take pride in their results.

The team of cloud solutions architects at Canonical works directly with customers to design private and public cloud solutions tailored to workload needs. Technologies include on-premise solutions like Openstack, MicroCloud, Ceph, and deployable solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Spark, PostgreSQL. Managers and team members deploy, test, and hand over solutions, and participate in presales to advise during sales processes.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview

Sequencing.com is on a mission to make advanced whole genome sequencing accessible and actionable for everyone. We’re a startup at the intersection of SaaS, eCommerce, and health tech - offering DNA testing kits, secure DNA data storage, and a growing marketplace of reports and proprietary AI tools that help people understand their genetic data. We’re looking for a customer-obsessed, data-savvy, and outcome-oriented Product Manager to bring structure to our roadmap and help us scale with purpose. This is a senior individual contributor role with high visibility and strategic impact. You’ll be responsible for managing high-impact product initiatives across the platform, driving execution from discovery through delivery. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-ownership environment, demands excellence in execution, and leads with clarity and decisiveness. You must have a builder’s mentality and a proven track record of releasing successful consumer-facing products.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and Drive the Product Roadmap: Maintain and enforce a focused product roadmap across our core platform, ensuring clarity of scope, priority, and impact. Track all features, bugs, and enhancements across Engineering, Design, Bioinformatics, and Customer Success.
  • Lead Discovery & Customer Insight Work: Combine qualitative and quantitative approaches to deeply understand our customers. Actively engage with users through interviews, testing, and platform usage, while also analyzing product and behavioral data to uncover patterns, friction points, and opportunities. Use both first-hand insights and data-driven findings to anchor product direction in real customer needs and outcomes.
  • Define & Scope Features: Translate customer insights and company goals into actionable product plans with clear documentation, timelines, and success criteria. Ensure projects are aligned with what moves the needle.
  • Execution Leadership: Collaborate cross-functionally to scope, de-risk, and deliver high-quality features at startup speed. Push teams toward urgency and disciplined execution.
  • Documentation Ownership: Write and maintain detailed product specs, user flows, success metrics, and timelines in Confluence and Jira. Your documentation will be the single source of truth.
  • Jira & Process Stewardship: Own the ROAD Jira board, ensuring tickets are properly structured, linked, and prioritized. Proactively manage dependencies, identify blockers, and support delivery cadence.
  • Product Communication & Strategic Thinking: Be a direct, clear communicator who can articulate priorities and say ‘no’ when needed. Protect the product from scope creep, stakeholder appeasement, or feel-good but low-impact projects.
  • Align, but Don’t Please: Collaborate effectively with stakeholders while prioritizing product quality and outcomes over consensus or politics. Communicate hard decisions without soft-pedaling.
  • Contribute to Product Culture: Raise the bar for quality, execution, and decision-making in a fast-paced startup environment. Help instill clarity, urgency, and discipline in the way we build.

What We’re Looking For

  • Customer-obsessed: You always start with the user and are proactive about talking to them. You’ve used our platform - or would have - before applying.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in SaaS, consumer subscription, or health tech.
  • Highly data-driven: You can track and act on business and user metrics and apply analytical rigor to prioritize effectively.
  • Proven track record of shipping and scaling consumer products, particularly subscription-based platforms.
  • Strategic mindset: You can connect high-level goals with actionable plans, and keep long-term vision front and center.
  • Mission-driven: You’re excited by the potential of genomics and motivated by real impact.
  • Exacting standards: You push for excellence and aren’t afraid to raise the bar.
  • Resilient to pushback: You don’t fold under pressure and remain firm when decisions are right.
  • Direct communicator: You value clarity over ambiguity and fairness over comfort.
  • Executional excellence: You have the organizational skills to juggle multiple initiatives while delivering results.
  • Builder’s mentality: You earn respect through work product, not charm, and lead through doing.
  • Respect without people-pleasing: You collaborate well but don’t need universal approval to drive results.

About Sequencing

Sequencing is powering the future of personalized health. We are the platform that transforms a person’s genome into a lifelong source of straightforward, actionable insights - for individuals, families, and healthcare professionals. By providing the application layer to your DNA, we turn complex genetic data into recurring value throughout every stage of life.

Our unique, clinical-grade Whole Genome Sequencing unlocks the most complete view of your DNA, screening for almost all known health conditions, traits, and medication responses - and translating that information into clear, actionable steps for managing health risks, optimizing wellness, and extending longevity.

As whole genome sequencing becomes a standard part of life, Sequencing is already the trusted platform where people safely store their DNA data - and will become the lifelong home for every genome on Earth.

We’re a fully remote, global team of innovators, scientists, and builders, united by a mission to make genomics accessible, actionable, and life-changing for everyone.

Proudly named GenomeWeb’s Best Place to Work in 2024, Sequencing is venture-backed and scaling rapidly to meet surging demand in the fast-growing personal genomics market.

If you’re excited to help redefine how the world thinks about health, join us in building the platform that brings every genome to life.

Sobre a Just a Little Data / B>P

Só um pouquinho de dados. Ou um montão deles.

A quantidade não é o mais importante, mas sim o uso que fazemos das informações. Na Just a Little Data, nosso papel é exatamente este: ajudar empresas - sejam elas multinacionais ou negócios locais - a potencializar o conhecimento por trás dos dados.

Para isso, contamos não só com um time feito de especialistas em business, tecnologia, comunicação e outras áreas, mas com toda a estrutura e apoio do grupo B&Partners , do qual fazemos parte.

Queremos revolucionar o processo de tomada de decisão nas empresas e tornar a ciência de dados mais acessível, para que ela seja uma vantagem competitiva de negócios de diversos segmentos.

Nosso clima é de startup, com desafios, projetos e oportunidades de desenvolvimento constantes. Valorizamos a criatividade, unicidade de bagagem, bem estar e autonomia das pessoas que atuam conosco. Afinal, são elas que fazem a empresa, e não o contrário. Se curtiu a ideia de somar com a gente, veja nossas vagas em aberto - uma delas pode ser a sua cara. E o seu perfil, a nossa.

Solucionar problemas e direcionar operações com tecnologia e ciência de dados da maneira mais prática e objetiva visando aumentar os resultados dos nossos clientes e parceiros.

Comprometimento e transparência nas relações (B2B e B2C);

Assertividade e precisão na entrega.

Diversidade

Aqui na Just, respeitar as identidades e valores de cada indivíduo não é só uma questão fundamental, mas obrigatória. Acreditamos que contar com pessoas de todos os tipos no nosso time é exatamente o que precisamos para nos desenvolver em todos os sentidos. Por isso, diferentes visões, bagagens e modos de ser são e serão sempre bem-vindos na nossa casa.

Como parte do grupo, somos signatários do Pacto Global da ONU, e lideramos dois importantes movimentos: Elas Lideram 2030 e Raça é Prioridade. Isso se traduz em metas claras: 50% de lideranças femininas e 50% de pessoas negras em posições de liderança, reforçando nosso compromisso com equidade real e contínua.

Somos uma empresa de tecnologia com um equilíbrio que nos orgulha! Aqui, mulheres são maioria, provando que inovação e diversidade caminham juntas.

Bora somar e deixar os gráficos abaixo cada vez menos padronizados!

Nossa forma de trabalhar é híbrida, mais para remota. Na Just, valorizamos o equilíbrio entre autonomia e alinhamento. Por isso, temos vagas remotas, híbridas e algumas que pedem presença em São Paulo, seja para encontros no escritório ou momentos conforme o escopo da vaga exigir. A gente sabe que para ter os melhores talentos ao nosso lado, um bom salário não é a única coisa que importa. Por isso, preparamos um pacote de benefícios completo para oferecer mais bem estar e qualidade de vida para todo time da Just! Confira os principais

description:
Overview

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master\'s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory and non-billable.

As a UI (User Interface) Artist, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing and intuitive user interfaces for mobile games and apps. You will collaborate closely with game designers, artists, and developers to design, implement, and optimize UI elements that enhance the overall gameplay experience and engage players.

The purpose of the role is to conceptualize, mock-up, and execute interface designs across many different systems, creating a visual and functional connection between the user experience and the game story. You will work with us to design and develop user interface styles, structures and flows integrated in our projects, augmenting gameplay systems and complementing the established art direction.

What you can expect

  • Profile Preselection: Our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile to ensure it aligns with our requirements and values.

  • Online Test: Qualified candidates will be invited to complete an online assessment to demonstrate their abilities.
  • Technical Interview: Finalists will participate in a technical interview to assess their proficiency and compatibility with our team when a project staffing plan is made.

We're committed to finding the best talent to join our growing team, and we look forward to connecting with you throughout this exciting process.

The Quest

  • UI Design: Create concept sketches, wireframes, and mockups for various UI screens, including menus, HUDs (Heads-Up Displays), overlays, and interactive elements. Develop cohesive visual themes and styles that align with the game's aesthetic and target audience.
  • Graphic Asset Creation: Design and produce high-quality UI assets, including icons, buttons, backgrounds, and visual effects. Use graphic design software to create scalable and visually appealing UI elements that enhance usability and accessibility.
  • Iconography and Typography: Select appropriate icons, symbols, and typography to convey information, enhance navigation, and communicate game mechanics effectively. Ensure consistency in iconography style, color schemes, and typography across all UI screens.
  • Animation and Motion Graphics: Implement animations and motion graphics to enhance interactivity, feedback, and visual interest within the UI. Create dynamic transitions, button animations, and visual effects that respond to player interactions and events.
  • User Experience (UX) Optimization: Conduct user research, playtesting, and usability testing to gather feedback and insights on UI design and functionality. Iterate on UI layouts, navigation flows, and interactive elements to improve user engagement, retention, and satisfaction.
  • Technical Implementation: Work closely with developers to integrate UI assets into the game engine (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) and ensure optimal performance across various mobile devices and screen resolutions. Collaborate on UI scripting and implementation tasks as needed.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with game designers, artists, programmers, and producers to align UI design goals with gameplay mechanics, narrative elements, and technical constraints. Participate in brainstorming sessions and provide creative input to enhance the overall game experience.
  • Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough testing and QA checks to ensure UI elements function as intended, adhere to design specifications, and meet performance targets. Identify and address any UI-related bugs, glitches, or usability issues in a timely manner.

The Skills

  • Ability to bring static UI elements to life through dynamic animations and visual effects. Experience with animation software (e.g., After Effects, Spine) and a passion for creating engaging animations and motion graphics within UI.
  • User-Centered Design , knowledge of UX principles and methodologies, including user research, usability testing, and iterative design. Ability to empathize with users and advocate for their needs throughout the UI design process.
  • Best practices for designing UI interfaces for touchscreen devices. Experience with mobile game engines (e.g., Unity, Unreal Engine) is a plus. Familiarity with mobile gaming industry and platform-specific UI/UX guidelines.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to convey ideas, concepts, and feedback to cross-functional team members. Comfortable giving and receiving constructive criticism in a team-oriented environment.

Overview

Senior Specialist, B2B Content Strategist (Bangkok Based, relocation provided) – Bangkok, Thailand. This role is based in Bangkok and open to candidates worldwide with a relocation package.

About Agoda

Agoda is an online travel booking platform for accommodations, flights, and more. We build and deploy cutting-edge technology that connects travelers with a global network of 4.7M hotels and holiday properties worldwide, plus flights, activities, and more. Based in Asia and part of Booking Holdings, our 7,100+ employees representing 95+ nationalities in 27 markets foster a work environment rich in diversity, creativity, and collaboration. We innovate through a culture of experimentation and ownership, enhancing the ability for our customers to experience the world.

The Opportunity

Join Agoda’s B2B Marketing team as a Senior Specialist, B2B Content Marketing and help shape the voice of our brand for partners worldwide. We’re looking for a creative, strategic, and results-driven content expert to craft, distribute, and manage impactful content across multiple platforms. Your work will engage our B2B audiences, elevate brand awareness, and drive real business results across our organization.

Role Overview

As a Senior Specialist, B2B Content Marketing, you will be responsible for the end-to-end content lifecycle: from ideation and creation to distribution and performance analysis. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across departments to develop a wide range of content (e.g. articles, emails, case studies, videos, social media posts) that resonates with our B2B partners. The ideal candidate will be an excellent writer and strong communicator with strong project management and stakeholder engagement skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content Development and Management: Create, distribute and manage useful and engaging content to attract, engage and retain our B2B partners.
  • Website Management: Manage and maintain PartnerHub and RocketTravel, our partner websites, collaborating with brand, vendors, and business units to create, update and manage web content.
  • Project and Stakeholder Management: Lead and coordinate cross-functional projects, ensuring clear communication and alignment among all stakeholders.
  • Performance Analysis: Track, measure, and report on content performance across channels, using insights to refine and optimize our content strategy.
  • Competitive Research: Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify opportunities for content improvement and innovation.
  • Social Media Management: Collaborate with PR to publish B2B-focused content on our social platforms and analyze performance to maximize reach and engagement.
  • Vendor Management: Onboard and manage external vendors as required.

What You’ll Need To Succeed

  • A minimum of 3 years in copywriting, content marketing, or related roles, preferably in the tech or travel industry. B2B marketing experience is a strong plus.
  • Exceptional writing and editing skills with demonstrated ability to write high-quality, effective content in different formats.
  • Experience with content management systems, SEO, and website analytics tools (Google Analytics). Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) is a plus.
  • Experience working with design teams to produce visually engaging content.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing and UX best practices.
  • Excellent project management, time management and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong communication skills and a confident, persuasive writing style (please be prepared to share your own writing samples).
  • Familiarity with the tech and travel industries, with experience in the online travel agency sector being a plus.

Why Join Us

At Agoda, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our communication strategies and driving growth within the B2B marketing division. If you are an innovative thinker passionate about travel technology and have the skills to elevate our brand narrative, we invite you to apply and be part of our dynamic team.

Equal Opportunity Employer

At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person’s merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.
